system.description:
Flurry Technique

You can spend your Action to take the Overflowing Malice stance until the beginning of your next turn. For the duration of this stance, once per turn, you can spend 3 Discipline to perform a Retributive Strike or Pensive Shot against a creature.

Retributive Strike. While you have a melee weapon equipped, if a creature enters or exits your weapons range, you can make a weapon attack targeting them, dealing your [Weapons Damage] + 1 Flurry Die and forcing them to make a Dexterity saving throw, being knocked prone on a failed save.

Pensive Shot. While you have a ranged weapon equipped, if a creature moves within 15 feet of you, you can make a weapon attack targeting them, dealing 2 Flurry Die in damage of the same type as your held weapon and forcing them to make a Dexterity saving throw, being restrained in place on a failed save until the beginning of their next turn.
